transcript.answer: To pass the `skill-help` PR check (`scripts/check-skill-help.sh`), every skill's SKILL.md (`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`) must end with a `## Help` section. That section's body must be fenced by `<!-- lore-help:begin -->` and `<!-- lore-help:end -->` markers, each alone on its own line. The markers are matched anchored to the start of a line. The block must contain a `**Summary.**` line and a `**Usage:**` line. It may also contain the optional `**Use when.**`, `**Not for.**`, `**Examples**` and `**Related:**` lines. The check fails if the block is missing or malformed. I did not find the script's exact code, so details beyond this come from the PR and spec descriptions.
